cohort: 68,673 pregnant women without COVID-19 and 1,386 pregnant women with confirmed COVID-19 in Brazil between March 2020 and May 2021
finding: Pregnant women infected with SARS-CoV-2 had a higher risk of maternal death, fetal death/stillbirth, preterm birth, cesarean delivery, and cesarean section occurring before the onset of labor.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 had a higher risk of cesarean delivery (RR 1.07-95%CI 1.02-1.11), and cesarean delivery occurring before the onset of labor (RR 1.33-95%CI 1.23-1.44).
